lavHelper: Helper Functions for lavaan Models

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

2026-11-28 06:16:26

Source: vignettes/lavHelper.Rmd
lavHelper.Rmd

Description

Helper functions for lavaan models (R Core Team, 2026): conversion between lavaan model matrices and reticular action model (RAM) matrices, the standardized solution from RAM matrices, and the parameter estimates of a fitted model including fixed parameters, defined parameters, and constraints.

Installation

You can install the development version of lavHelper from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/lavHelper")

Example 

library(package = "lavHelper")

A regression of mpg on wt and disp fitted with lavaan.

fit <- lavaan::sem(
  model = "mpg ~ b1 * wt + b2 * disp",
  data = mtcars
)
lav_mod <- lavaan::lavInspect(
  object = fit,
  what = "est"
)

Lav2RAM() converts the lavaan model matrices to RAM matrices.

ram <- Lav2RAM(
  lav_mod = lav_mod
)
ram$A
#>      mpg        wt        disp
#> mpg    0 -3.350825 -0.01772474
#> wt     0  0.000000  0.00000000
#> disp   0  0.000000  0.00000000

StdRAM() gives the standardized solution.

StdRAM(
  ram_est = ram
)$A
#>      mpg         wt       disp
#> mpg    0 -0.5439967 -0.3644932
#> wt     0  0.0000000  0.0000000
#> disp   0  0.0000000  0.0000000

RAM2Lav() converts RAM matrices back to lavaan model matrices.

RAM2Lav(
  ram = ram,
  lav_mod = lav_mod
)$beta
#>      mpg        wt        disp
#> mpg    0 -3.350825 -0.01772474
#> wt     0  0.000000  0.00000000
#> disp   0  0.000000  0.00000000

ThetaHat() extracts the parameter estimates, including the fixed parameters.

ThetaHat(
  object = fit
)$est
#>            b1            b2      mpg~~mpg        wt~~wt      wt~~disp 
#> -3.350825e+00 -1.772474e-02  7.708828e+00  9.274609e-01  1.043191e+02 
#>    disp~~disp 
#>  1.488077e+04
